subject: planner: fix the row count for index join use the PK in inner side (#65190)
summary: Reviewed the planner-only changes in `pkg/planner/core/exhaust_physical_plans.go` and `pkg/planner/core/index_join_path.go` against the first parent. The change gates the inner TableScan stats 1-row cap behind a `maxOneRow` predicate (unique index + full-column match + equality access), fixing underestimation for CommonHandle prefix probes while keeping the unique-match cap for true PK/unique lookups; also refactors the repeated `rangeInfo`/`maxOneRow` computation into `indexJoinPathGetRangeInfoAndMaxOneRow`. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness/semantics/transaction behavior; impact is confined to rowcount/cost estimation and plan choice. Checked later history up to `upstream/master`; the key logic remains present (no later revert/fix indicating a hidden Blocker/High regression).
